_doc: Zero-token gates run by tools/dispatch-precheck.js before dispatchOne opens a worker tab. Key = EXACT os_scheduled_tasks.name. The argv's last stdout line must be JSON {verdict: skip|spawn, reason}; anything else spawns. Re-read on every dispatch, so edits need no restart. Set enabled:false to bypass one.
